[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended factors to consider for a beginner badminton racket: material (graphite or aluminum), weight (around 80-90 grams), balance (head-light or even-balanced), and grip size (comfortable for the hand).

3. **Apacs Feather Weight 55**: Extremely lightweight (55g), easy to handle.  
4. **Babolat Satelite Lite**: Lightweight (90g), head-light design, good power.
